title: .cursorignore negation does not re-include a file inside an ignored folder
symptoms: The file stays hidden from Agent although a ! line names it
cause: Excluded directories are not traversed, so a negation for a file below the excluded level is never seen. This matches how gitignore handles nested negation.
fix: Exclude the nested folder's contents explicitly, then negate the file, and test the pattern with git check-ignore -v.
